test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some actresses are hair stylists.

All hair stylists are anchors.

**Conclusions: **

1. Some hair stylists are actresses.

2. Some anchors are hair stylists.
solution:
According to the given statement:

1. Some actresses are hair stylists.

2. All hair stylists are anchors.

The possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/406d5da7ffc9b00c1ef3fb527a1af0194190b3187e6a2bca9585022926f53b74.png] 

Conclusion:

1. Some hair stylists are actresses. **True** (As some actresses are hair stylists is a definite conclusion then some hair stylists are actresses will also be a definite conclusion).

2. Some anchors are hair stylists. **True** (Since all Hair stylists are Anchors, so some Anchors be hairstylist is a definite conclusion).

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions 1 and 2 follow**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Suppose for an Example: All A are B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/343041d8a2f5008fe30b0360a5c22f53cce0592cc6e4f66418d07f0a9530f348.png] 

If we go from In to Out means from A to B then cases with All and some will be true like All A are B and Some A are B.

But if we go Out to In then only cases with Some will be true and All will be can't say like Some B are A will be true but All B are A will be can't say.
